description: This Java class 'RequestResponseFilter' extends 'OncePerRequestFilter' and logs details of incoming HTTP requests and outgoing responses within a web application, acting as a servlet filter.

classes.name: RequestResponseFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that logs incoming HTTP requests and outgoing responses for monitoring/debugging within a Spring-based web application.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the method from 'OncePerRequestFilter' to insert logging before and after the web request processing.
